title: How to reset your password
content: To reset your password, go to the login page and click 'Forgot password'. Enter the email address on your account and we will send a reset link. The link expires after 30 minutes. If you don't receive the email, check your spam folder or request a new link.

title: Refund policy
content: We offer full refunds within 30 days of purchase for any reason. To request a refund, go to Account > Orders, select the order, and click 'Request refund'. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days and returned to the original payment method.

title: How to cancel a subscription
content: You can cancel your subscription anytime from Account > Billing > Manage subscription > Cancel. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. You will keep access until then and will not be charged again.

title: Updating billing information
content: To update your credit card or billing address, go to Account > Billing > Payment methods. Add a new card and set it as default, or edit your existing card details. Changes apply to your next billing cycle.

title: Shipping times and tracking
content: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days within the country and 7-14 business days internationally. Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number by email. You can also view tracking info under Account > Orders.

title: Account is locked or suspended
content: Accounts are temporarily locked after 5 failed login attempts for security. Wait 15 minutes and try again, or reset your password. If your account was suspended for a policy violation, you will have received an email explaining why and how to appeal.

title: Contacting a human agent
content: If the chatbot can't resolve your issue, you can escalate to a human support agent. Agents are available Monday-Friday, 9am-6pm. Typical response time is under 2 hours during business hours.
